name: Somchai Srisuk
bio:
Somchai's journey into the complex world of motorsport IT began unexpectedly, fueled by a lifelong fascination with technology and a chance encounter at a local racing event. Previously working in enterprise IT support, he was drawn to the fast-paced, high-stakes environment of racing, recognizing the pivotal role IT plays in performance and strategy. Eager to contribute, he took a significant pay cut to join a small racing team as a junior IT technician, determined to prove his worth. 

Somchai's pragmatic approach is his greatest asset. He prioritizes practical solutions and reliable systems over flashy innovations, ensuring the team's data infrastructure runs smoothly and securely. He believes in building a strong foundation, meticulously documenting every process and proactively identifying potential vulnerabilities. His goal is to become a cornerstone of the team's technical operations, quietly but effectively driving improvements in data analysis and communication. 

What sets Somchai apart is his ability to bridge the gap between the technical and the human element. He understands that even the most advanced systems are only as good as the people who use them, and he is committed to providing clear, concise training and support to ensure everyone on the team can leverage IT effectively.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly parted on the left
physical.description: Somchai has a gentle face and a slender build, often seen with a focused expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with system diagrams.
Insists on using a mechanical keyboard, even in the noisy garage.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when concentrating.
